nodes.summary: Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $A$ be a real $n \times n$ matrix, let $\Phi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$, and let $t \in \mathbb{R}$. If $\Phi$ is differentiable at $t$ with $\Phi'(t) = A \Phi(t)$, then $s \mapsto \det \Phi(s)$ is differentiable at $t$ with derivative $\operatorname{tr}(A) \det \Phi(t)$.
nodes.title: Jacobi's formula when the derivative is a left multiple of the matrix

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, write $L(E)$ for the space of continuous linear maps $E \to E$ with the operator norm, let $B : \mathbb{R} \to L(E)$ be continuous, and let $t_0 \in \mathbb{R}$ and $x_0 \in E$. Then there is exactly one function $x : \mathbb{R} \to E$ with $x(t_0) = x_0$ such that $x$ is differentiable at every $t \in \mathbb{R}$ with $x'(t) = B(t)\,x(t)$.
nodes.title: Global existence and uniqueness for homogeneous linear ODEs
